name: Portworld Panel Hardware Control
description: Controls the built-in hardware of Portworld wall panels such as the YC-SM08P: the RGB side light as a select of colours and effects, and the optional presence sensor as an occupancy sensor with gesture triggers. Both reach Home Assistant through Kiosk Satellite's ESPHome entities, with no MQTT or scripts on the panel. Tested on the RK3576 YC-SM08P; needs the firmware's su.
author: patrick11994

settings.title: Blinks for flash once
settings.description: How often the flash once and flash and off effects blink before they settle.

settings.title: Person detected trigger
settings.description: Fire the Person detected gesture trigger when someone comes near. Pick what it runs under Gestures > Plugin trigger.

settings.title: Nobody detected trigger
settings.description: Fire the Nobody detected gesture trigger when the sensor clears.

settings.title: Clear after
settings.description: Seconds the sensor must read empty before presence turns off. 0 follows the sensor directly.

settings.title: Check every
settings.description: Seconds between readings of the sensor.

settings.title: Sensor reads 0 when someone is there
settings.description: True on the RK3576 YC-SM08P. Turn off if presence shows the opposite of reality.

settings.title: Red LED GPIO
settings.description: Linux GPIO number of the red channel. Only change this for another revision of the panel.
